# Joshua Harris writes about the role of legal finance in life sciences innovation


- Patent & IP


January 15, 2025


-
-
-
-


[Joshua Harris](https://www.burfordcapital.com/about-us/our-team/joshua-harris/) writes for *IAM* about how legal finance can "unlock" the value of life sciences innovation.


The article describes how businesses in the life sciences sector are using financial tools to manage risk, which includes leveraging legal finance to monetize their IP.


[Read the full article here.](https://www.iam-media.com/article/how-legal-finance-can-unlock-the-value-of-life-sciences-innovation)
